x.description: (..., M, N) array_like The matrix whose condition number is sought.
constraints: M and N must be positive integers

p.description: {None, 1, -1, 2, -2, inf, -inf, 'fro'}, optional Order of the norm used in the condition number computation:
constraints: p must be one of: None, 1, -1, 2, -2, 'inf', -'inf', or 'fro'

output.description: ------- {float, inf} The condition number of the matrix. May be infinite.
